summary: Negotiators separate wording repairs from amendments that would change who can accept the bill.
realLife: Dirksen grouped his proposed civil rights revisions by whether they clarified language or changed policy.
inGame: needs: amendment text, the sponsor's classification and a record of contested classifications.

turns.what: A member moves a supposed drafting fix into the policy discussion.
turns.pulledBy: Counsel shows that the change would exclude a group covered by the current text.
turns.writesBack: The amendment is considered as a substantive change.

turns.what: Counsel divides one amendment into a correction and a separate concession.
turns.pulledBy: A single edit changes both a reference and an eligibility condition.
turns.writesBack: Members can vote on the two changes separately.
